sections.title: Equipped with Tamura’s original “in-fire convection control” technology

blocks.text: Controlling the convection in the furnace reduces the maintenance frequency. Equalizing the oxygen concentration in the furnace reduces nitrogen consumption.

sections.title: Equipped with high-speed model switching function

blocks.text: Tamura's original temperature setup system can significantly reduce the reflow waiting time when changing setups.
Tamura's unique sensing of flux residue announces required maintenance and prevent s unexpected line stoppage.

sections.title: Reliable quality:Improved maintainability of the transport mechanism

blocks.text: Informs the user of lubrication requirements by accumulating the mileage of transport system. A special syringe applies lubricant automatically. This reduces maintenance and minimizes the risk of metallic foreign matter from improper maintenance of the transport system.

In addition to Tamura's original setup change system, traceability with mounter companies and automatic setup change system are available. We always deliver the latest system to meet the needs of automation and labour saving.
